intro: Threat from Below is a Horde bounty tasking adventurers with hunting down a dangerous sea giant prowling Durotar's north coast. Overcoming such an enormous coastal titan protects the nearby shores and earns the respect of the warriors of Durotar.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ha! I could hear his body fall from here!
Be proud of your kill today; not many can claim they survived a fight with a sea giant.
